class.name: OcgGCMakearcofparabola
class.brief_description: Implements construction algorithms for parabola arcs in 3D space. The result is a `Geom_TrimmedCurve`. A MakeArcOfParabola object provides a framework for: - defining the construction of the arc of parabola, - implementing the construction algorithm, and - consulting the results. In particular, the Value function returns the constructed arc of parabola.
